description: Source code for the internal class 'InvokableGenerator' in Orleans CodeGenerator, responsible for generating RPC invoker classes for remote method calls, including creating class declarations, methods, fields, constructors, and handling serialization and invocation logic.

classes.name: InvokableGenerator
classes.description: Internal class for generating RPC invoker classes for Orleans, handling class structure, methods, constructors, fields, and serialization details.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Main method to generate a descriptive class for a given invokable method, assembling class declaration, namespace, and serialization hooks.

methods.name: GetClassDeclarationSyntax
methods.description: Creates the syntax representation of the class declaration, including base types, members, attributes, and optional timeout properties.

methods.name: GenerateResponseTimeoutPropertyMembers
methods.description: Creates class members for response timeout properties.

methods.name: AddOptionalMembers
methods.description: Helper to add optional methods to a class declaration.

methods.name: GetCompoundTypeAliasAttribute
methods.description: Creates an attribute syntax node for a compound type alias.

methods.name: GetCompoundTypeAliasAttributeArguments
methods.description: Fetches argument components for compound type alias attributes based on method description.

methods.name: GetCompoundTypeAliasComponents
methods.description: Generates components for a compound type alias, including proxy base and containing interface.

methods.name: GetBaseClassType
methods.description: Determines the base class type for invokable class based on method return type and predefined mappings.

methods.name: GenerateSetTargetMethod
methods.description: Creates the 'SetTarget' method for setting the invocation target object.

methods.name: GenerateGetTargetMethod
methods.description: Creates the 'GetTarget' method for retrieving the invocation target object.

methods.name: GenerateGetCancellationTokenMethod
methods.description: Creates method for fetching the CancellationToken if the method is cancellable.

methods.name: GenerateTryCancelMethod
methods.description: Creates method to attempt cancelling the ongoing invocation if cancellable.

methods.name: GenerateGetArgumentMethod
methods.description: Creates method for retrieving method arguments by index.

methods.name: GenerateSetArgumentMethod
methods.description: Creates method for setting method argument value by index.

methods.name: GenerateInvokeInnerMethod
methods.description: Creates the core invocation method that calls the underlying target method with the stored arguments.

methods.name: GenerateDisposeMethod
methods.description: Creates the Dispose method which cleans up resources such as cancellation tokens.

methods.name: GenerateGetArgumentCount
methods.description: Creates method to return the number of method arguments.

methods.name: GenerateGetActivityName
methods.description: Creates method returning a string used as the activity (span) name for tracing.

methods.name: GenerateGetMethodName
methods.description: Creates method returning the method's name as string.

methods.name: GenerateGetInterfaceName
methods.description: Creates method returning the interface name as string.

methods.name: GenerateGetInterfaceType
methods.description: Creates method returning the interface type object.

methods.name: GenerateGetMethod
methods.description: Creates method returning MethodInfo object for the method.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Static method generating a unique class name based on method details.
